spanish: Bastante a ustedes el rodear este monte; volteen faces para ustedes hacia el norte.

findings.issue: פְּנוּ is one qal imperative 2mp of H6437 (turn). The Spanish adds the unmarked noun faces, which this token does not license.

notes: The rest tracks רב לכם, infinitive סב, את ההר הזה, לכם, and directional צפנה with ustedes address.
